review.description: S2 preserves private execution-status records and prevents late-failure diagnostics from exposing prompt, answer, output or provider-error content. Existing credential, scoped authority and real-host boundaries remain unchanged.
review.implementation: statusStore still removes run/job/step outputs and all iterations and replaces errors with generic text without mutating the private in-memory run. The new asynchronous diagnostic contains only originating turn/thread identities and a fixed generic message; it does not serialize runErr.
review.tests: Inspected TestStatusStoreSerializationOmitsPrivateOutputsAnswersAndErrors: distinct canaries at run/job/step/iteration/nested-step levels are absent from the actual saved JSON while status/identity remains and original private execution is unmodified. Late-failure callback test rejects prompt/answer/error canaries and retains native policy/follow-up. These fixtures do not close real-host gaps.
